description: This file defines a React component for a modal that conducts an AI-generated quiz in a course module. It manages quiz state, interacts with external APIs for quiz generation and submission, and renders UI for quiz flow including questions, answers, and results.

methods.name: handleStart
methods.description: Initiates quiz generation by calling generateAiQuiz API, sets up questions and state for quiz start.

methods.name: handleAnswer
methods.description: Records the selected answer for the current question.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Submits the collected answers to the submitAiQuiz API and processes the response.

methods.name: handleRetake
methods.description: Resets state to allow retaking the quiz.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Closes the modal by calling onClose callback.
